mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines in the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 105.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that raises recession risks and corporate earnings uncertainty, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent price pressures that prompt restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases and nonfarm payrolls declines signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO increases in prior month, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.
